port_types.chat: A conversation turn: text plus prior session turns.
port_types.documents: An ordered list of retrieved or loaded documents ({text, score?, metadata?}).

conversions.rule: Join document texts with a blank line.
Wrap as a single user turn.
Parse as JSON; otherwise wrap as {"input": text}.

condition_operators.description: Input does not contain the argument (case-insensitive).
Input matches the regular expression (RE2 subset, at most 200 characters).
Input has more characters than the integer argument.

template_variables.{context}: Every inbound value converted to text and joined with a blank line.
template_variables.{<node-id>}: The text output of a specific upstream node.

components.label: Chat input
components.description: The message a user sends to the agent. Every graph has exactly one.

components.label: Chat output
components.description: The agent's reply. Every graph has exactly one.

components.label: Prompt
components.description: Render a text template from the input and upstream outputs.

config.label: Prompt template
config.help: Use {input} for the message, {context} for inbound values, or {node-id} for one upstream node.

components.label: Model
components.description: Generate text with the platform chat model, or call a deployed Kionga model.

config.label: Model
config.help: llm uses the platform chat model configured for the runtime. A Kionga model ID calls that deployed model's endpoint.

config.label: System instructions
config.help: Optional instructions sent before the input when using the platform chat model.

components.label: Kionga tool
components.description: Invoke a registered Kionga tool through its serverless function.

config.label: Tool
config.help: A tool registered in the Kionga catalog. Kionga checks your access on every call.

components.label: API call
components.description: Call an administrator-approved API connection; Kionga adds the credential server-side.

config.label: API connection
config.help: An API connection registered for this project.

config.label: Request body template
config.help: Rendered, then sent as JSON. Text that is not JSON is sent as {"input": text}. Empty sends {"input": {input}}.

components.label: Knowledge base
components.description: Search a project knowledge base (Qdrant or pgvector) and return matching documents.

config.label: Knowledge base
config.help: Queries are embedded with the SDK hashing embedder at the base's dimensions; ingest with the same embedder.

config.label: Search query
config.help: Use {input} to search with the agent message.

components.label: Dataset object
components.description: Load a text object from an authorized project dataset in RustFS object storage.

config.label: Dataset
config.help: A dataset assigned to this project; Kionga confines reads to its prefix.

config.label: Object key
config.help: Key relative to the dataset prefix.

components.label: Condition
components.description: Route the inbound value to the true or false branch. Only the taken branch runs.

config.label: Condition
config.help: operator:argument, for example contains:refund, matches:^order-[0-9]+$, longer_than:200, empty.

components.label: Conversation memory
components.description: Prefix the input with the most recent turns of this session.
